title: Transcriptomic Analysis Revealed the Common and Divergent Responses of Maize Seedling Leaves to Cold and Heat Stresses.
tissue: seedling leaf (second leaf; leaves of the seedlings pooled per replicate)
growth_system: growth chamber; soil/substrate in plastic pots (12 seeds sown, 8 uniform seedlings kept); 25/22 °C (written 'day/light cycle'), 60% humidity; photoperiod NR
cold_treatments: 4 °C for 2 h (ELT); 10 °C for 2 h (MLT); 16 °C for 2 h (LT)
other_factors: heat treatments in same experiment (37 °C 2 h; 42 °C 2 h; 48 °C 1 h) vs same NT control; no recovery
timepoints_duration: single exposure of 2 h per cold temperature; all samples collected at 2 p.m. (treatments started at staggered times)
bio_reps: 3 (each replicate = pooled second leaves of seedlings)
key_finding: B73 leaf: 5358/5485/5312 DEGs at 4/10/16 °C vs 25 °C; 189 shared with heat; WGCNA hubs include DREB1/CBF.
notes: Reads mapped to B73 v4 (HISAT2, DESeq2); DEG counts from abstract; very short (2 h) cold exposure; run-level SRA IDs not given in text.

title: Identification of candidate tolerance genes to low-temperature during maize germination by GWAS and RNA-seq approaches.
genotypes: RNA-seq: Zao 8-3 (low-temperature tolerant; labelled 55) and Ji 853 (sensitive; labelled 102), picked from a 222-inbred GWAS panel (panel used for phenotyping/GWAS only)
stage_age: germinating seed; 6 h imbibition at 25 °C, then sampled 2 h after imbibition on germination paper at treatment temperature (wording of Methods)
growth_system: germination paper in dark chamber (germination assays); separate field sowing trials at XiangYang, Harbin and KeShan (Qiqihar) 2018 for phenotypes only (not RNA-seq)
cold_treatments: 10 °C (LT) for 2 h for RNA-seq; phenotyping: 10 °C for 31 d then 15 °C for 7 d recovery
other_factors: tolerant vs sensitive line (RNA-seq); GWAS of 14 relative germination traits (222 lines)
timepoints_duration: RNA-seq at 2 h at 10 °C vs 25 °C; qRT-PCR validation at 2 h and 4 h
n_libraries: 12 (2 lines x 2 temperatures x 3; computed from design)
other_omics: GWAS (Illumina MaizeSNP50, 40,697 SNPs, 222 inbreds); germination phenotypes; qRT-PCR
key_finding: Embryo RNA-seq of tolerant vs sensitive lines at 10 vs 25 °C plus GWAS (30 SNPs) nominates Zm00001d039219 and Zm00001d034319.
notes: GSE146666 found by web search (OmicsDI/GEO title 'RNA-seq for two maize inbred lines', 10 vs 25 °C germination) because the accession was missing from the extracted full text; not confirmed in paper text. RNA-seq contrasts are line x temperature; ref genome B73 v4. Wording of sampling time is ambiguous.

title: Transcriptomic diversity in seedling roots of European flint maize in response to cold.
genotypes: 21 doubled-haploid lines from European flint landrace 'Petkuser Ferdinand Rot' (11 cold tolerant, 10 susceptible, by root growth ratio cold/control)
tissue: primary root tip (max 1 cm, meristematic and elongation zone; 10 roots pooled per sample)
growth_system: growth chamber; germination paper rolls standing in 10 L buckets with ca. 3 L distilled water; 16 h light/8 h dark; control regime 26/18 °C day/night
cold_treatments: 12 °C for 8 h (cold) for RNA-seq; phenotyping (separate): 16/12 °C day/night for 2 d
other_factors: cold-tolerant vs susceptible DH lines; growth rate at cold
timepoints_duration: 8 h treatment, single time point; phenotyping 2 d
other_omics: root growth phenotyping of 276 DH lines (GiA Roots)
key_finding: 148 genes respond to cold, 3254 associate with cold tolerance and 563 with growth rate at cold in flint DH root tips.
notes: Discussion calls 12 vs 18 °C the cold vs control night temperatures; whether the 8 h treatment fell in light or dark is not explicit. Mapped to B73 v4 (about 75% unique mapping).

title: Deletion of maize RDM4 suggests a role in endosperm maturation as well as vegetative and stress-responsive growth.
genotypes: B73-background rdm4 null deletion mutant (gamma-radiation derived; opaque kernel) vs wild-type siblings (genotyped by PCR)
tissue: seedling leaf (abstract/results say leaf; Methods say 'seedling RNA')
growth_system: seeds germinated in peat pots with potting compost in greenhouse, then Conviron growth chamber; 16 h day/8 h night
cold_treatments: 10 °C for 3 d (seedling10); 10 °C for 3 d followed by 2 °C for 1 d (seedling2, 'near freezing')
timepoints_duration: end of 3 d at 10 °C; end of 1 d at 2 °C after 3 d at 10 °C
bio_reps: 3 per group (inferred from 18 seedling libraries = 2 genotypes x 3 conditions x 3; endosperm text states 3 replicates)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2500 PE125 (University of Minnesota Genomics Center)
other_omics: proteomics (endosperm LC-MS/MS), amino acid content, zein SDS-PAGE, qRT-PCR
key_finding: WT: 8410 (10 °C) and 10,559 (2 °C) cold DEGs; 25.9% and 40.8% lose cold response in rdm4.
source_of_details: publisher accepted-manuscript PDF (PAR) via web fetch; PubMed abstract
notes: No PMC full text. PRJNA306879 may also hold other RNA-seq/exome data from the same group (BSR-seq); run-level IDs not given. Aligned to B73 v4 with TopHat2/Cufflinks.

title: Transcriptomic profiling revealed genes involved in response to cold stress in maize.
other_omics: chlorophyll fluorescence; membrane lipids/fatty acids; secondary metabolites
key_finding: Tolerant M54 protects photosystems and upregulates secondary metabolism and unsaturated fatty acid genes more than 753F under cold.
source_of_details: PubMed abstract + web search (full text not read)
notes: Needs full-text check for temperature, tissue, stage, replicates, platform. PRJNA385245 taken from a FAIDARE/ENA record titled 'Zea mays cultivar:M54,753F Raw sequence reads' described as low-temperature stress; not confirmed in the paper. CSIRO accepted-PDF fetch timed out (not retried). A second record PRJNA385354 (water stress) is not this study.

title: Changes in photosynthesis and respiratory metabolism of maize seedlings growing under low temperature stress may be regulated by arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi.
cold_treatments: NR (low temperature stress; value not in abstract)
other_factors: arbuscular mycorrhizal fungus inoculation (AMF vs non-inoculated); 4 groups: NMA, MA, NML, ML
platform_layout: NR (abstract and PubMed keywords indicate RNA sequencing)
key_finding: AMF inoculation under low temperature: 858 genes up, 497 down; photosynthesis and respiration genes changed (10,400 DEGs overall).
source_of_details: PubMed abstract + web search (full text not accessible)
notes: No PMC full text; two searches found no accession, genotype or temperature details. Full-text check needed. Cold vs ambient contrast exists within both AMF and non-AMF plants.
